Subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint — POC trial milestone tracking

Hi Harper —

Following our kickoff last week, attaching the initial MAP items and milestone cadence for the 30-day POC. Goal for this thread: keep a running weekly checkpoint so we can surface blockers early and confirm acceptance criteria.

Summary (high level):
- POC window: Mar 10 — Apr 8
- Success criteria: integration ingest, 2k inference calls/day at <200ms 95p, privacy controls validated on test dataset
- Next demo: Mar 18 (scheduled tentative)

Action items for this week (first pass):
1) Redwood to provide evaluation criteria doc and testing config — Jasmine / Ben — due Mar 10
2) Northbridge to confirm dataset slice and legal/data security contacts — Harper — due Mar 11
3) Redwood infra to provide SOC2 artifact list and access plan — Vivek — due Mar 12

Please let me know if any dates look off — otherwise I’ll update the attached MAP and we’ll run a 20-minute checkpoint next Monday.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(Attachment: evaluation-criteria.pdf)
From: Harper Flynn <harper@northbridge.health>

Cc: Northbridge POC Team <poc-team@northbridge.health>
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 09:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint — POC trial milestone tracking

Thanks Jasmine — helpful framing. A few clarifications/constraints from our side: 

- Acceptance criteria we care most about: 1) ability to anonymize PHI fields in output, 2) consistent response quality on 5 reference prompts (we'll provide), 3) sustained throughput of 1.5k calls/day during business hours (we can spike for stress).
- Blocker: our security team needs a SOC2 artefact packet and a short readout before we enable any test data in the POC environment.
- Legal: may need a brief SOW revision to reflect retention policy (we have an internal template).

I attached our evaluation rubric (simple scoring per prompt) — will share the actual prompt set by EOD.

Harper
Director, Digital Platforms | Northbridge Health
(Attachment: northbridge-eval-rubric.pdf)
